corrections.reason: The canonical Ge'ez feminine plural pronoun referring to አባግዕ (sheep) is እማንቱ ('they [fem. pl.] follow me'), clearly printed on the page.

Standard Andemta Christological expression 'እዱ መዝራዕቱ ከተባልሁ' ('since I am called His hand and His arm [መዝራዕቱ]'). Visually, ዝራ was misread as ንፈ and the 6th-order ል before ሁ on the next line was misread as 1st-order ለ.
Translates the Ge'ez root 'ዘቀደሶ አብ' ('whom the Father sanctified/united'). Visually, the printed word after the verse number ፴፮ is አብ, which was misread as ልክ due to ink wear.
